last.verdict: EVgo cut its 2026 outlook a second time, and the stock now hinges on LS Power's unsolicited $2.00-a-share buyout proposal.

takeaways.label: Buyout offer
takeaways.text: Majority owner LS Power proposed buying all remaining shares for $2.00 cash on Nov. 2. A special committee is reviewing it, and no decision or deal is certain.

takeaways.label: Second guidance cut
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook fell to $375-400M from $400-430M. The adjusted EBITDA loss forecast widened to $15-30M from $5-25M. Stall additions are now guided at 1,075-1,275.

takeaways.label: Charging up, total flat
takeaways.text: Charging revenue grew 29% to $72M, but total revenue slipped 1% to $91.4M as automaker-partner (eXtend) revenue halved. Net loss widened to $49.2M from $28.4M.

takeaways.label: Cash and debt strain
takeaways.text: Cash fell to $98.7M from $151M at year-end while long-term debt rose to about $312M from $204M. Capex after offsets hit $24M, versus $4M a year ago.

history.verdict: Investors sold EVgo after the company cut its full-year outlook and cash burn rose.

reasons.label: Lower 2026 outlook
reasons.text: Revenue guidance cut to $400-430M from $410-470M; below analysts' roughly $433M.

reasons.label: Bigger expected losses
reasons.text: Full-year adjusted EBITDA now a $5-25M loss, versus a range reaching up to +$20M before.

reasons.label: Cash and slower ramp
reasons.text: Operating cash burn widened and new stalls ramped slower than hoped, despite Tesla deal.
